components.css: .ds-board{background:#101A40;border:1.5px solid rgba(244,241,234,.9);border-radius:12px;color:#F4F1EA;font-family:Barlow,sans-serif;width:340px}.ds-board h2{margin:0;padding:14px 16px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(244,241,234,.2);font:600 16px 'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:22px 1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:12px 16px}.ds-row i{width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #F4F1EA;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 #E8262F}.ds-row i.hub{width:20px;height:20px;border-width:4px}.ds-row .chap{font:600 17px 'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}.ds-row b{font:600 22px 'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif}.ds-row small{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;opacity:.72;margin-left:2px}

narrative.overview: Each book is a metro line fired in midnight-blue enamel: chapters are stations, parts are interchanges, the listener is the train. Station type, a departures board and a draggable line answer 'where am I and how long until the next stop' at a glance.
keyCharacteristics: Midnight enamel ground / cool porcelain tile in light
Barlow Condensed station caps over Barlow
Outlines for depth, one soft shadow for floating things

rules.name: One Line, One Ink
rules.body: A book's identity is its ink; it marks position, heard progress and the primary action only.

rules.name: Station Caps
rules.body: Anything you navigate to is set in condensed capitals; reading text stays in Barlow sentence case.

rules.name: Outline, Not Shadow
rules.body: Panels carry a 1.5px rule; only floating elements cast the single soft shadow.

dos: Do draw structure as lines and stations.
Do scale minutes-away by playback speed.
Do keep light mode cool porcelain.
donts: Don't show book content in the public shell.
